Required findings: Diagnosis of cervical cancer with intact cervix
Clinical staging performed prior to treatment initiation
Use of CT-based treatment planning and image guidance is required for IMRT due to cervical mobility and tumor shrinkage
IMRT is indicated for definitive treatment to decrease toxicity risk
IMRT is indicated for grossly involved pelvic nodes with planned dose of 60 Gy or higher
Extended field radiation therapy is indicated for grossly involved paraaortic nodes, recurrent disease without distant metastasis, or gross involvement of common iliac lymph nodes
Medical necessity indications.Source: Radiation Oncology Guidelines For Treatment by Site > Cervical Cancer > DISCUSSION (TOC: S4.8.1)

Required findings: History of simple or radical hysterectomy

Surgical findings indicating increased risk of recurrence: positive pelvic/para-aortic nodes, close (<0.5 cm) or positive surgical margins, parametrial involvement, large primary tumor, deep stromal invasion, or lymphovascular invasion
Whole pelvis treated to 45 Gy or higher
IMRT is considered medically necessary in the post-hysterectomy setting
Intracavitary boost may be appropriate for positive surgical findings
Medical necessity indications.Source: Radiation Oncology Guidelines For Treatment by Site > Cervical Cancer > DISCUSSION (TOC: S4.8.1)

Required findings: Evidence of locoregional recurrence only
No evidence of distant metastatic disease
Salvage radiotherapy with up to 30 fractions of 3DCRT
IMRT approved only if comparative 3D and IMRT plans demonstrate 3D plan does not meet 'Acceptable' normal tissue constraints per RTOG/NCCN metrics
Medical necessity indications.Source: Radiation Oncology Guidelines For Treatment by Site > Cervical Cancer > DISCUSSION (TOC: S4.8.1)

Required findings: Non-curative setting
Presence of symptoms
Treatment with conventional isodose technique or 3DCRT using up to 4 gantry angles
Up to 15 fractions and 1 phase
IMRT or Brachytherapy considered medically necessary only if previous external beam radiation therapy or brachytherapy has been given to the same or abutting region
Medical necessity indications.Source: Radiation Oncology Guidelines For Treatment by Site > Cervical Cancer (TOC: S4.8)

Required findings: History of previous radiation to the same or abutting region
Inability to deliver therapeutic doses of radiation with other techniques
Medical necessity indications.Source: Radiation Oncology Guidelines For Treatment by Site > Cervical Cancer (TOC: S4.8)

Non-Indications: Electronic brachytherapy for the treatment of cervical cancer
SBRT as an alternative to brachytherapy in the definitive treatment of cervical cancer (considered Experimental, Investigational, or Unproven)
IMRT for locoregional recurrence or palliation when comparative 3D and IMRT plans demonstrate that the 3D plan meets 'Acceptable' normal tissue constraints
Palliative IMRT or Brachytherapy without a history of previous external beam radiation therapy or brachytherapy to the same or abutting region
Important criteria & exceptions: IMRT in definitive treatment of intact cervix requires CT-based treatment planning and image guidance
For LDR brachytherapy, up to 2 interstitial or intracavitary applications are medically appropriate
For HDR interstitial therapy, up to 5 fractions (1 application) or up to 3 fractions (2 applications) are appropriate
For HDR tandem and ovoids, up to 6 applications are appropriate
For HDR vaginal cylinder, up to 3 applications are considered medically necessary

Concurrent cisplatin-based chemotherapy is strongly considered for FIGO stages IB1 to IVA treated with primary radiation or FIGO stages I to IIA with poor prognostic factors receiving adjuvant chemoradiation
Documentation required: Clinical staging report performed prior to definitive treatment
Surgical pathology report detailing tumor size, depth of stromal invasion, lymphovascular invasion, margin status, and nodal status for postoperative cases
Imaging reports (CT/MRI) demonstrating grossly involved pelvic or paraaortic lymph nodes if extended field or high-dose boost is planned
Comparative 3D and IMRT treatment plans demonstrating normal tissue constraint violations for IMRT approval in recurrence or palliation settings
Records of previous external beam radiation therapy or brachytherapy if requesting IMRT, Brachytherapy, or SBRT for re-irradiation scenarios
